Introduction.

# Data

## Community

```{r data_com}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
com <- read_csv("data/DadosComunidade.csv")
com |> 
  head() |> 
  kable()
```

## Environment

```{r data_env}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
env <- read_csv("data/DadosAmbiente.csv") |> 
  rename(Parcela = parcela)
env |> 
  head() |> 
  kable()
```

# Analyses

## PCA

```{r pca_env}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
autoplot(princomp(select(env, -Parcela), 
                  cor = TRUE), 
         data = env, alpha = 0.25,
         loadings.label.size = 6,
         loadings.label.colour = 'red', loadings.label.vjust = 1.1,
         loadings.label.repel   = TRUE,
         loadings = T, loadings.label = T, loadings.colour = 'red') +
  coord_equal() +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0), col = 'black', linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), col = 'black', linetype = "dotted") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r pca_com}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
pca_data <-  na.omit(com)
autoplot(princomp(select(pca_data, -Numarvore, -Parcela, -GRT_ano, -Height, -Light), 
                  cor = TRUE), 
         data = pca_data |> left_join(env), alpha = 0.25,
         loadings.label.size = 6, col = "hand30",
         loadings.label.colour = 'red', loadings.label.vjust = 1.1,
         loadings.label.repel   = TRUE,
         loadings = T, loadings.label = T, loadings.colour = 'red') +
  coord_equal() +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0), col = 'black', linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), col = 'black', linetype = "dotted") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_viridis_c()
```

## CWM

```{r cwm}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
cwm <- com |> 
  select(-Numarvore, -GRT_ano, -Height, -Light) |> 
  group_by(Parcela) |> 
  summarise_all(mean, na.rm = TRUE)
cwm |> 
  head() |> 
  kable()
```

```{r cwm_fig}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10
cwm |> 
  gather(trait, trait_value, -Parcela) |> 
  left_join(env) |> 
  gather(env, env_value, -Parcela, -trait, -trait_value) |> 
  ggplot(aes(env_value, trait_value)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_grid(trait ~ env, scales = "free") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  xlab("") + ylab("") +
  ggpubr::stat_cor()
```

## Regressions

```{r reg_tab}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
all_reg <- cwm |> 
  mutate(across(-Parcela, ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)))) |> 
  gather(trait, trait_value, -Parcela) |> 
  left_join(env |> 
              mutate(across(-Parcela, ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))) |> 
  group_by(trait) %>% 
  nest() |> 
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ lm(trait_value ~ altitude + inclinacao + hand30 + bases_cmolkg + P_mg_kg + Argila + Silte, data = .x))
  )
sjPlot::tab_model(all_reg$model, dv.labels = all_reg$trait)
```

```{r reg_fig}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
all_reg |> 
  mutate(coefs = map(model, ~broom::tidy(.x, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.90))) %>% 
  unnest(coefs) |> 
  select(-data, -model) |> 
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = term, col = term, alpha = (p.value < 0.05))) +
  geom_point(aes(y = estimate)) +
  geom_segment(aes(y = estimate - std.error, yend = estimate + std.error)) +
  geom_segment(aes(y = conf.low, yend = conf.high), linewidth = .1) +
  facet_wrap(~trait) +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_flip() +
  xlab("") + ylab("")
```

```{r reg_ex}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
cwm |> 
  gather(trait, trait_value, -Parcela) |> 
  left_join(env) |> 
  gather(env, env_value, -Parcela, -trait, -trait_value) |> 
  filter(trait == "FTP", env == "bases_cmolkg") |> 
  ggplot(aes(env_value, trait_value)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_grid(trait ~ env, scales = "free") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  xlab("") + ylab("")
```
